newsitem.title: INDIA: India cotton prices rise on delayed arrivals news.
newsitem.headline: India cotton prices rise on delayed arrivals news.

text.p: Indian cotton prices rose on Thursday on reports of a delay in new arrivals, dealers said.
They said reports of a disease threatened cotton crop in northern India also boosted market sentiment. There were no details of the disease.
In spot deals Gujarat Kalyan rose by 200 rupees to 14,000/14,200 rupees per candy (355.56 kg) while wagad cotton moved up by 200 rupees to 12,000/12,200.
Bengal-deshi was steady at 875/900 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) for the spot delivery while October delivery was traded at 930/940 rupees. -- Bombay Commodities +91-22-265 9000
